arguments.name: positionName
arguments.description: The name of the new Benefit Clearance Head position to create (e.g., 'IT Operations Lead', 'Finance Manager', 'HR Coordinator').

raw.name: positionName
raw.description: The name of the new Benefit Clearance Head position to create (e.g., 'IT Operations Lead', 'Finance Manager', 'HR Coordinator').

arguments.name: employeeId
arguments.description: The employee ID to assign to this position (e.g., '000001', '00000006'). The system will search for this employee and assign them to the new position.

raw.name: employeeId
raw.description: The employee ID to assign to this position (e.g., '000001', '00000006'). The system will search for this employee and assign them to the new position.

arguments.name: createWorkflowApproval
arguments.description: Whether to enable workflow approval for this position. Use 'true' to enable or 'false' to disable. Defaults to false if not provided.

raw.name: createWorkflowApproval
raw.description: Whether to enable workflow approval for this position. Use 'true' to enable or 'false' to disable. Defaults to false if not provided.
